gloss: text of a law; article; provision

definitions.gloss: text of a law; article; provision
definitions.explanation: The written text of individual articles or clauses in laws, regulations, treaties, or contracts.

examples.japanese: {条文|じょうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the text of the provision.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{条文|じょうぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}→解釈：02603_kaishaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is debate over the interpretation of this provision.

examples.japanese: ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{条文|じょうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ→一つ一つ：27163_hitotsuhitotsu⟧⟦{読|よ}み{直|なお}す→読み直す：29840_yominaosu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to reread each article of the constitution one by one.

notes:
{条文|じょうぶん} refers to the actual written text of individual articles or clauses in legal documents. A formal term used in legal, political, and academic contexts.

COMPOUND: {条|じょう} (article/clause) + ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (text/writing)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {条文|じょうぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}→解釈：02603_kaishaku⟧: interpretation of the provision
- {条文|じょうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to amend the text
- {条文|じょうぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧: based on the provision
- ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{条文|じょうぶん}: the text of the constitution
- {条文|じょうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read the provisions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{条項|じょうこう}→条項：18974_joukou⟧: article, clause (refers to the clause itself as a unit)
- ⟦{法令|ほうれい}→法令：13299_hourei⟧: laws and ordinances (broader term)
- ⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧: regulation, stipulation (the rule itself, not its text)
